notes.content:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752220/300


Welcome to close-quarters heaven!
Society had abandoned me.
I worked all day, but all I could think about was feeling up girls on the train.
Nobody would ever understand.

Catch your targets, tease them, and give chase when they run. 
And after that, well...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/9f63868bbc5f38fabb1f1dd171218bafca00c3d7.gif[/img]


This train is PACKED!
With all those bodies crammed together, there's really nowhere to run or hide.
What fate awaits our heroines amid the writhing mass of humanity...?

notes.title: 《Spiritbound: The Goddess's Quest》store page has been released!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/12a1c3b7d8766689f7f7d6d5666ead7afcfcb960.png[/img]
[h2][b]Add to Wishlist NOW!![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3421410/
[hr][/hr]

[h2]＊Story＊[/h2]
All over the world, there are well-known haunted places, and one of them is particularly eye-catching and dangerous...
That place is the ""Haunted House"".
Many people have been abused there, but even the police are helpless about the ghosts.
The troubled people involved decided to hire an exorcist to expel the evil spirits,
But after the exorcism, they found that the evil spirits here are very powerful, and all the spells don't work!
Finally, the frustrated exorcists decided to go to the shrine to ask the goddess for help—
Thus, the goddess's exorcism mission begins!

[h2]＊How to play＊[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/60395a51d54fb97b7b4f5f98b2ac5b78e5d6a2fb.png[/img]
▲Explore the map
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/b1480b9370b8014186a33218b5e98a05b95fe9bd.png[/img]
▲Look for clues base on hints
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/13963689c64ae354849cfcbd528a3321f675b9e6.png[/img]
▲Talk to evil spirits and exorcise them

[h2]＊Character＊[/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45479601/07bfb3b00fad3e427278dede20227aefb904b90a.png[/img]
Hatsune, a cute goddess.
She is very interested in human food.

[h2]＊Game Features＊[/h2]
[list]
[*] Simple classic RPG
[*] Easy gameplay without fighting
[*] Watch the story of evil spirits
[*] Includes some voice acting and sound effects
[/list]
